before_every_operation: RESOLVE focus file: if active_service known → systems/<system_name>/context/focus/<service>.md else → systems/<system_name>/context/current_focus.md (or dev variant)
CHECK locks: acquire required exclusive locks under systems/<system_name>/context/sync/locks/ before modifying exclusive resources
CONFIRM system_name, active step/stage, next action, outstanding gates
refresh_sequence: APPEND current action+rationale to process_log.md (or dev_process_log.md) under context/
UPDATE progress tracker (step/stage, timestamps, blockers, evidence refs)
RELOAD authoritative specs: specs/machine/index.json and relevant service specs
RESTATE: system_name, active unit, next action, gates

snapshot_management.frequency: Every 2 operations OR on boundary exit

iteration_principles: On validation failure, iterate to the nearest corrective workflow (local fix) before escalating back
On cross-service contract changes, route to Feature Update FU-02 Arch Re-Engineering
Resume at the original workflow after successful re-alignment

self_improvement.format: JSONL - one object per line per /home/ajs7/project/saa/reflow/process_improvements/template.json
rules: Suggestions MUST be generic and system-agnostic
No system/service names, no secrets, no external tokens
